answer: Sybil clones flood the emission harbor with lookalike agents. Mechanism: each entrant burns a 3.7 POA onyx bond and must solve a walnut-hardness sequential-memory puzzle keyed to their invite parent's 14-day spend graph; only solvers with at least 3 distinct parent lineages may dock. Cost: 3.7 POA burned plus roughly 90 seconds of CPU. Verify: the harbor gate rejects any bond lacking the walnut proof hash on-ledger. Failure: forged walnut proofs that fail re-check forfeit the full onyx bond to random attestors.
